# Linear design tokens

<!-- Generated by apps/saturn-tauri/scripts/build-token-docs.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Semantic tokens come from `linear-theme.css`, `app-accent.css`, `linear-layout.css`, `01-editor.css`, and `00-tokens-glass.css`.
Contrast pairs are enforced by `pnpm check:contrast` at WCAG AA (4.5:1 text on cards/surfaces).

## Surface invariant

- Solid matte surfaces across both themes (`#1C1C1C` dark / `#FFFFFF` & `#F8F9FA` light), Orange primary accent (`#F97316` dark / `#C2410C` light); zero green/teal hues, zero blur, zero translucent UI chrome.
- Shared card shadow uses `--shadow-card` (`0 12px 28px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)` dark, `0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / 5%)` light).
- Motion uses `150ms ease-out`; `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` collapses durations cleanly.
